title: Live HUD: layout test with a screen-cover knob
description: Add the knob live.hud_max_cover (PLACEHOLDER) to content/ui/default.yaml and to the theme schema. Then add an edit-mode Unity test that builds the live HUD, lays it out at 1280x720 and 3840x2160, checks that each group sits in its corner, and checks that the at-rest screen cover is within the knob.
acceptance_criteria: Done when: content/ui/default.yaml and the theme schema carry live.hud_max_cover; a new edit-mode test builds the live HUD, lays it out at 1280x720 and 3840x2160, asserts each group sits in its corner and the at-rest cover is within the knob; just unity-tests passes.
